items.title: How consumer stablecoin apps are structuring wallet-balance yield after the GENIUS Act interest ban
items.snippet: Been talking with a couple of program managers about how the interest ban is landing on consumer product design, and the answer at the product layer looks different from the mainstream takes. The GENIUS Act prohibits the issuer from paying yield to holders. It says almost nothing about what a third-party wallet or exchange is allowed to do with the same balance. The OCC NPRM in February tried to tighten that with a rebuttable presumption on affiliate arrangements, but the comment period closed...
